news.title: Lighting up blue for the Brewers
news.summary_en: UW–Madison celebrated the Milwaukee Brewers’ first World Series championship with a splash of team colors on campus buildings.

news.title: Badger Caregiving Clinic helps to address caregiving crisis
news.summary_en: More than 1 million people in Wisconsin provide unpaid care to a family member or friend. A new pilot program led by UW–Madison researchers aims to offer them training and support at no cost.

news.title: Cyclotron expansion to accelerate precision medicine
news.summary_en: UW–Madison advances imaging, treatment and medical isotope production with $62 million expansion.

news.title: Quantum, fusion and AI stand out during DOE leader’s campus visit
news.summary_en: The Department of Energy’s Darío Gil took part in a daylong visit that emphasized UW–Madison’s strengths across a number of research areas, as well as key public-private partnerships that advanced the Wisconsin Idea.

news.title: Battiato named interim University Staff secretary
news.summary_en: Kate Battiato assumes the role as John Lease, her predecessor, retires on Oct. 30.

news.title: A movie about war, college football and two heroic Badgers
news.summary_en: 'The Mosquito Bowl' opens in theaters this weekend with a re-creation of UW–Madison’s Camp Randall in the 1940s.

news.title: National biotechnology commission visits UW–Madison to explore research and innovation
news.summary_en: From advances in agricultural science and sustainable bioenergy to medical breakthroughs to new automated technologies, UW–Madison is shaping the future of biotechnology.

news.title: Out of left field
news.summary_en: During a record-breaking season for the Brewers, a rare artifact from Milwaukee baseball history was unearthed at the UW–Madison Libraries. Campus experts are racing against time to preserve artifacts just like it.

news.title: Gourd vibes only
news.summary_en: In the days leading up to Halloween, UW–Madison students got creative with their pumpkin decorating endeavors.

news.title: Ever-green Morgridge Hall
news.summary_en: The new home of the College of Computing & Artificial Intelligence is the most sustainable building on the UW–Madison campus.

news.title: Neutrinos, Bucky and a brass section
news.summary_en: Thousands honored UW–Madison physics professor Francis Halzen, the university's newest Nobel laureate, at Memorial Union on Oct. 23.

news.title: UW–Madison policies address nepotism and consensual relationships in the workplace
news.summary_en: These policies are in place to ensure fairness and transparency in our workplace.
